views.name: bowler_score_game_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Bowler_Scores.MatchID AS MatchID,
  Bowler_Scores.GameNumber AS GameNumber,
  Bowler_Scores.BowlerID AS BowlerID,
  Bowler_Scores.RawScore AS RawScore,
  Bowler_Scores.HandiCapScore AS HandiCapScore,
  Bowler_Scores.WonGame AS WonGame
FROM Bowler_Scores
views.description: Row-level Bowler_Scores records representing a single bowler's single game (no aggregation). Keeps the raw score, handicap score and win flag per game for joining to match/tourney metadata.

views.name: match_game_to_tourney
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  mg.MatchID,
  mg.GameNumber,
  tm.TourneyID,
  t.TourneyDate,
  t.TourneyLocation
FROM Match_Games AS mg
JOIN Tourney_Matches AS tm ON tm.MatchID = mg.MatchID
JOIN Tournaments AS t ON t.TourneyID = tm.TourneyID
views.description: Denormalized mapping of Match_Games (match/game) to its tournament metadata via Tourney_Matches -> Tournaments, one row per match game. Exposes tourney id, date and location for each MatchID/GameNumber.

views.name: bowler_win_handicap_by_location
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bsg.MatchID,
  bsg.GameNumber,
  bsg.BowlerID,
  mgt.TourneyID,
  mgt.TourneyLocation,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN bsg.WonGame = 1 AND bsg.HandiCapScore <= 190 THEN 1 END) AS qualifying_game_count
FROM
  bowler_score_game_rows AS bsg
JOIN
  match_game_to_tourney AS mgt
  ON bsg.MatchID = mgt.MatchID AND bsg.GameNumber = mgt.GameNumber
GROUP BY
  bsg.BowlerID,
  mgt.TourneyLocation,
  bsg.MatchID,
  bsg.GameNumber,
  mgt.TourneyID
views.description: Per-bowler, per-tournament-location indicator rows showing whether the bowler has at least one qualifying winning game (WonGame=1 and HandiCapScore <= 190) at that tournament location. Useful to test that a bowler has qualifying games at each of a set of locations.
